label: VERIFIED
extraction: Obsidian Agent (TheManuelML): Lightweight AI extension for Obsidian. Connects Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or local Ollama. Agent can write, edit, create notes/folders. User-friendly UI with chat management as Obsidian notes (rename file to rename chat). Tools: List files in folder, Vault Search across content, Note filtering by criteria, Read note content, Write note content, Create note, Delete note, Move note. Chat files store history and metadata. Hotkey access. Clone to ~/vault/.obsidian/plugins/ to install.
